properties.description: Five tests on the acceptance surface: a baselined artifact accepted as design_holds with no change_type is refused and the refusal names the repair labels and the reconcile labels; a stated reason is recorded as given; a repair may still be accepted as a repair; a first baseline needs no reason; the bulk form refuses the silent item and names it.
